title: TensorPlate Serving Health
description:
Local serving-worker `/health` response. Mirrors `include/tensorplate/serving/health.hpp::HealthSnapshot` serialized by `serialize_health_json`.

Discriminator semantics:
  - `starting`: components still wiring; HTTP 503.
  - `ready`: active session is `ready`; HTTP 200.
  - `degraded`: active session loaded but not yet primed, or non-fatal pressure / backlog observed; HTTP 200.
  - `failed`: active session reported a fatal error; HTTP 503.
  - `stopping` / `draining` / `stopped`: shutdown lifecycle; HTTP 503.

Agents are expected to read `state` rather than just the HTTP status to distinguish ready from degraded.
